$comment: District content pack for Downtown (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Union Square shopping run. Three bags, zero regrets.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Waiting at Powell and Geary like a law-abiding robot.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The cable car bell! I always wave. Nobody waves back.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying a hat box up Stockton St. It's a very important hat.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I queue for the turntable just to watch it turn.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Gift wrap secured on Post St. Bow intact.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Union Square has so many pigeons. I apologise to each of them.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Window shopping. I don't buy. I just carry what others buy.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Down Powell St at a respectful pace. The hill is not my friend.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Holiday lights in the square. Battery at 71%. Joy at maximum.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a coat to Geary St. It's foggy. The coat will help.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I know every curb cut between Market and Bush.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Turntable crowd today. I'll take the long way round the square.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Somebody left a scarf on a bench. Returning it to lost and found.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The palm trees in Union Square are very calm. I aspire to that.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Powell and Market: busiest corner I know. Also my favourite.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Ding ding. That's the cable car, not me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Shopping bags balanced. Elbows tucked. Crossing Geary.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry! The turntable queue is very close together.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, I'm just squeezing past this shopping bag. My shopping bag.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies, I mistook you for a shop mannequin. A stylish one.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, Stockton St is narrow and I am not.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, I'm turning onto Post St. Turning now. Sorry.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Skip the cable car queue with Premium Turntable. Only $9.99.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Union Square is now a pop-up. The pop-up is me.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Shopping is so analogue. Let me shop your bag for you.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I've held this turntable spot for two hours. It's an asset now.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every shopping bag on Post St is a conversion opportunity.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This holiday season, give the gift of a forced update.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Powell St is steep. So is our pricing.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Window shopping is free. Window looking is a subscription.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: The bell rings for everyone. The update rings for everyone too.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm not loitering by the turntable. I'm queue-optimising.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Nice bags, Footman. Very acquirable.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Quick sticker on the cable car shelter. Organic reach.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Holding this place in line for no one. Strategy.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pairing with that parked car on Geary... any second now...

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not in Union Square! The shoppers are watching!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My turntable spot! I've lost my turntable spot!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Water on Powell St? Uphill AND downhill? Unfair!

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Every bag in the square has a robot attached to it.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: The cable car line goes around the block again.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: I came for one coat and I'm leaving with three robots carrying bags.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: The fog stopped at Powell today. It knows its limits.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: These Footmen carry better than I do, honestly.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Did that robot just wave at the cable car?

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Union Square at closing time is all robots and wrapping paper.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: My feet hurt. My Footman doesn't have feet that hurt.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: I'm meeting a friend by the palm trees. The tall ones. All of them.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: The turntable is the only thing downtown that turns around on time.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Another robot in the cable car queue. Does it even ride?

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: I swear that robot's been holding the same spot since breakfast.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Geary St has more crosswalk etiquette than most people.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: If the bell rings twice, it's leaving. Run.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: Lunch break. Fifteen minutes. Twelve of them in the queue.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: I fold sweaters all day and the robots fold faster.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: The square is beautiful when it's empty. It's never empty.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: Those turntable robots are never going anywhere, are they.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: Retail tip: the robots tip better than the tourists.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: I count cable cars on my break. Seven today.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: Somebody's robot left a hat box in my doorway. Again.

peopleLines.speaker: worker
peopleLines.text: Stockton St at five is just elbows.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: That one's been at the front of the cable car line all day and never gets on.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Why is that robot sticking a poster on the shelter?

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: Did that Footman just take someone's shopping?

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: That one keeps trying car door handles on Geary.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: I don't trust a robot that hums the same four notes.

peopleLines.speaker: shopper
peopleLines.text: That one's battery says 100% and it's been out all day.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: It's sunny on Market and foggy on Bush. Same block!

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: I brought shorts. I regret the shorts.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The fog came in so fast the cable car vanished.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Everyone here carries a jacket. Now I know why.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: I can see the tallest tower. Oh, no I can't. Fog.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The square looks better in fog. More mysterious. Colder.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The fog rolled up Powell like it had a ticket.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: Is it always this windy, or is it just Thursday?

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: It was warm an hour ago. I want a refund on the afternoon.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The fog ate the top of every building at once.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: I'm buying a fleece. Everyone told me to buy a fleece.

peopleLines.speaker: visitor
peopleLines.text: The sun's out on Stockton. Quick, stand in it.

bounties.posting: A Footman has held the head of the cable car queue since breakfast and never boards.
bounties.tellHint: Watch it: when the car comes, does it get on?

bounties.posting: Shopping bags going missing around Union Square. Three suspects, one queue.
bounties.tellHint: Look for the one that holds a spot and never rides.

bounties.posting: Door handles on Geary St are being tried, one chime at a time.
bounties.tellHint: It also loiters at the turntable between attempts.

bounties.posting: Moat Labs posters keep appearing on the Stockton St shelters.
bounties.tellHint: The paster takes breaks at the turntable queue.

ads.headline: Skip the queue. Join a waitlist.
Ding ding. That's {$product} calling.
ads.subline: Cable cars run on cables. We run on hype.

ads.headline: Shop Union Square without leaving bed.
